author: Corridor Crew
description:
L’Inferno (1911) is a real piece of cinema history.

Widely considered the first-ever blockbuster, it was the first feature film shown in its entirety in one sitting in the USA (lasting over 1h), the first to surpass $2 million in revenue (today's 70$ million), and the first ever film that showcased dozens of VFX in a single movie. 

Did you even know this film existed? You can find it for free on YouTube!
title: They did THESE VFX in 1911?!
